title: 1번: Useless Traits from Our Ancestors
fullPassage: Over time, certain biological and behavioral features of humans stop serving a purpose. Instead of disappearing completely, they remain intact but have no function. This is what happened with the grasp reflex. If you place an object in an infant's hand, he or she will automatically grab it. This reflex was helpful for our distant ancestors, whose babies had to hold tightly to their mothers' fur. But the grasp reflex is of little use to human babies now, as they don't have to cling for survival. Another unnecessary feature we inherited from our ancestors is goose bumps. Goose bumps occur when we are cold or frightened and the hairs on our body stand straight up. Today, they are anything but useful. But they kept our hairy ancestors warm because the erect hairs prevented body heat from escaping. They also made our ancestors appear larger, helping them scare away predators.
